details.description: Llama 2 70B is the base, 70-billion-parameter pretrained model and the largest of Meta's three Llama 2 sizes, trained on 2 trillion tokens of publicly available text between January and July 2023 with a pretraining data cutoff of September 2022, per Meta's model card. As a pretrained (non-chat) model it performs text completion on a prompt and can be adapted to a variety of natural language generation tasks, in contrast to the fine-tuned '-b-f' chat variant built for dialogue. Meta's Hugging Face organization now lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind the current Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4 families.
advantages: Scores 68.9 on MMLU and averages 71.9 on Meta's grouped commonsense-reasoning benchmarks, the highest of the three Llama 2 pretrained sizes, per Meta's model card.
Reports 50.18% on TruthfulQA (percentage of truthful and informative generations), the highest of the three Llama 2 pretrained sizes, per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: Base pretrained model only, not instruction- or chat-tuned; Meta positions the fine-tuned '-b-f' chat variant for assistant-like dialogue.
Meta states intended use is commercial and research use in English, and that safety testing 'has not covered, nor could it cover, all scenarios.'
Superseded by later Llama generations: Meta's Hugging Face organization lists Llama 2 in a legacy 'History' section behind Llama 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4.
Pretraining knowledge cutoff of September 2022, per Meta's model card.
use_cases: General-purpose text completion and natural language generation
Base checkpoint for further fine-tuning or research, per Meta's model card

sources.title: Llama 2 foundation models from Meta are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart

notes: This is the SageMaker JumpStart artifact for the base (non-chat) Llama 2 70B pretrained model. AWS's launch blog documents the '-f' suffix for the chat id but names it 'meta-textgeneration-llama-2-70b-f'; the actual deployed id in this catalog target is 'meta-textgeneration-llama-2-70b-b-f' (extra 'b'), which a third-party SageMaker model catalog (mlflow) also lists with mode='chat', consistent with this base model's separate 'meta-textgeneration-llama-2-70b' id (mode='completion') and the catalog's /v1/completions endpoint. Benchmark table on the Hugging Face model card is shared verbatim across all Llama 2 HF repos; only pretrained-model rows (MMLU, TruthfulQA) are used here. Catalog's 4096/4096 token limits match Meta's stated 4,096-token context.
